problem_statement.value: My 2019 Honda CR-V 2.0L i-VTEC engine misfires intermittently at low idle speed, especially when cold and after a long park, with the check engine light sometimes flashing and stalling at stops. It has 148,000 km, stock plugs, a 2017 battery replaced in 2024. No other warnings. I want the root cause and a concrete redesign of the idle air control and camshaft profile so the misfire is eliminated.
